sentences.en: Lamgmuir-Blodgett (LB ) films is a monomolecular layer or mulitimolecular layer thin film material of organic high polymer with orientation arrangement structure.

sentences.en: Increasing temperature also led to the reaction from monomolecular to bimolecular mechanism.

sentences.en: On the monomolecular film 23, lipid bilayer 24 consisting of phospholipid is formed utilizing self assembly.
